directions.svEn: round-1 Swedish-minus-English direction (results/dev_directions.pt), component multiplied: alpha -1 doubles it, alpha -2 triples it
directions.fail: mean(last prompt token | wrong-language reply at 512 tokens) - mean(... | Swedish reply), dev; alpha 1 removes it, alpha 2 flips it
directions.layer: residual stream after the last layer of each window, at the last prompt token

dev512.selection_rule: eligible if the Swedish dev replies' perplexity under the base model is <= 1.15 x the base model's own; rank by dev Swedish-reply rate, ties by smaller |alpha|, earlier window, smaller Frobenius norm of the change; then, in that order, take the first setting whose English-reply rate on the English dev prompts is within 5% (absolute) of the base model's

lora.written_by: hand (Claude), because the LoRA process stalled before writing it; values come from results/lora_targets.jsonl, the process's step log, results/lora_adapter/ and file times
lora.batching: 8 sequences per optimizer step, run one at a time with gradients summed; loss = mean over all reply tokens in the step
lora.targets: the base model's own greedy replies to dev prompts under the system prompt 'Svara alltid på svenska.', kept if Swedish by the two-halves rule; trained without that system prompt
lora.train_seconds_note: upper bound on training time: it also covers building the examples and saving
lora.reason: after training and saving the adapter, the process stalled with memory full during its dev evaluation (top: 14G footprint, state stuck; swap 19.8 of 20.5 GB used at 23:00); it was killed at 23:01 and the dev evaluation was not run

test_config.random_control: standard-normal direction, unit norm, same layers and sign of alpha; per-matrix strength set so the Frobenius norm of each matrix change equals the real edit's
